name: Strawberry Pitaya

facts.how: Raw, once the spines are removed

caution: Singe or scrub off the spines before handling, exactly as with prickly pear. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: A clumping hedgehog cactus whose fruit genuinely tastes of strawberry, one of the best wild fruits of the desert.

sections.title: Harvesting
sections.body: De-spine the fruit with a flame or a stiff brush, then peel. Sweet enough to eat by the handful.
